in_sanskrit.name: उपयन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Upayan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'upa' meaning 'near' and 'yan' meaning 'go'. It can be interpreted as 'one who goes near'.

in_hindi.name: उपयान
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Upayan is translated to 'उजड़े हुआ' in Hindi, which can be interpreted as 'one who has arrived' or 'one who has emerged'.

in_tamil.name: உபயன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Upayan is translated to 'உடல்களிக்கும்' in Tamil, which can be interpreted as 'one who is close to the gods'.

in_telugu.name: ఊపయన్న
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Upayan is translated to 'ఊపదేశి' in Telugu, which can be interpreted as 'one who is near the lord'.

in_marathi.name: Upayan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Upayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Upayan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'upa' which means near or towards, and 'ayan' which means vehicle, thus Upayan means 'one who guides or leads towards'. This name is also associated with the god Vishnu who is considered the preserver of the universe and the one who guides souls towards the path of righteousness.
